# Living project checkpoint: TradeLink SEO automation

_Last status checkpoint: 2026-10-16, late evening (Claude session, production-readiness pass). This issue is the canonical **working status** for future assistant/Claude handoffs. It is not authorization to publish. The detailed checkpoint is in the latest comment below._

## Objective and permanent operating rules
- Build a **real research-driven SEO agent** for TradeLink (`usetradelink.com`), combining Google Search Console, Semrush, verified competitor research and authentic TradeLink product facts.
- Prioritize **qualified traffic, conversions and measurable results**, not page count, keyword stuffing or AI-detection evasion.
- When authorized, the agent researches, audits, drafts, tests, proposes and creates PRs automatically. **Every public website change requires a new, specific human approval** before publication.
- Keep `PUBLISHING_ENABLED=false` until every step before step 15 of [`docs/ops/activation-checklist.md`](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/blob/claude/festive-lamport-7ttt72-release-automation/docs/ops/activation-checklist.md) is done.
- Never expose secrets, spend more API units, merge, or deploy public website changes without explicit authorization. **Semrush: no further billable requests.** Every path is now fail-closed (see #19).

## Evidence and review
- [Full-repository audit, issue #10](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/issues/10)
- Test results come from Claude's local runs (Postgres 16) **and** GitHub Actions CI.
- The **real-deployment check** (`deploy-verify`) runs on GitHub's runners against the actual Cloudflare preview of each PR.
- Railway, Slack, Search Console and live Semrush are **not** verified: Claude's sandbox cannot reach them.

## Release structure: merge only these, in order (all drafts, unmerged)
| PR | Contents | Base | Notes |
|----|-------|------|----|
| [#18](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/18) | **Site release**: #13 + #15 + #17, plus real deployment verification and the Semrush MCP lock for assistants | `main` | **Changes the public site.** Merge after Cloudflare is switched to `_site` |
| [#19](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/19) | **Automation release**: #8 + #9 + #11 + #12 + #16 on top of #18, the Semrush lockdown, engine fixes, campaign 1, activation checklist | #18 | Retarget to `main` after #18 |
| [#20](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/20) | SEO proposal 1: one page answers "how to copy trade on Tradovate" (480/mo) | #18 | Content |
| [#21](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/21) | SEO proposal 2: answer "how to copy trade on Topstep" (140/mo) | #18 | Content |
| [#22](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/22) | SEO proposal 3: source and date `/futures-trade-copier/` (140/mo, KD 6) | #18 | Content |

#8, #9, #11, #12, #13, #15, #16 and #17 are fully contained in #18/#19; `git merge-base --is-ancestor` was checked for every head. Do not merge them separately. Close them once #18 and #19 are merged.

## Activation status (full ordered list: `docs/ops/activation-checklist.md`)
- **NEEDS MY APPROVAL:**
  - Cloudflare build → `_site`
  - Merge #18, then #19
  - Proposals #20–#22
  - Arm publishing
  - Engine-opened PRs
  - Semrush budget
  - Claude drafting
  - Product-claim decisions
- **NEEDS CONFIGURATION:**
  - Import the `main` ruleset
  - Railway source branch `main` + Wait for CI + PR Environments off
  - Create `seo-engine` and `seo-dashboard`
  - Read-only DB role
- **BLOCKED (owner must confirm):**
  - Current Railway variables
  - Search Console service-account access
  - Slack PB Assist round trip

## Product-owner decisions needed
1. **NinjaTrader:** the homepage FAQ says it's supported; everything else says Tradovate only. Blocked in the facts registry.
2. **"Ten protection rules":** on the homepage, in `llms.txt` and in the TradeSyncer comparison. #20 removes it from the Tradovate guide. The quality gate now catches it in table cells too.
3. **Competitor claims:** re-verify the TradeSyncer trial and annual discount, and the Tradecopia trial, then cite each one inline. Campaign item 5.
4. **Tracking/consent:** unchanged; needs a separately scoped approval.

## Handoff convention
For **each substantive project update made with an assistant**, update the status in this issue:
- date
- factual code and deploy state
- linked PR, CI and evidence
- decisions and approvals
- unresolved blockers
- next action

When a prior status becomes outdated, update it rather than representing it as current. Never claim work was applied if it was only proposed, and do not assume future automatic updates from other sessions or tools.

## Checkpoint 2026-10-16 (evening): blockers fixed, research engine built

Nothing was merged, deployed or enabled. All work is in draft PRs.

### Phase 1: outstanding blockers
| Item | Status | Where |
|---|---|---|
| CI on #11/#12/#13 | All green; Python bytecode accidentally committed in #11–#13 removed | #11, #12, #13 |
| Publishing directory | **Fixed in code.** `scripts/build_site.py` publishes an allowlist into `_site/`, fails on any `.py/.md/.json/.yml/.sql`, and is tested to equal exactly the public tracked files. Needs a Cloudflare build-setting change (below). | #15 |
| Railway deploys from dev branches | **Mitigated in code.** `armed()` requires `RAILWAY_GIT_BRANCH ∈ PUBLISH_ALLOWED_BRANCHES` (default `main`). `/health` shows the deployed branch and commit. `watchPatterns` limit redeploys to each service's own folder. The branch switch itself must be done in Railway. | #11, #12 |
| Branch protection + gated deploy | Importable ruleset `.github/rulesets/main-protection.json` (PR + `site-checks` required, no bypass). `deploy-site.yml` deploys through a `production` environment with required reviewer and is skipped until `SITE_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true`. Runbook in `docs/ops/publishing-and-protection.md`. | #15 |
| PB Assist / EmailCreator | Code-level: non-`seo_*` interactions get an empty 200, so EmailCreator interactions are not answered with SEO errors. **Unverified live:** I was not permitted to read the EmailCreator repo, and the Slack hosts are unreachable from here. | #11 |
| Technical SEO / performance | `_headers` security headers. Logo 178→48 KB. Screenshots 438→89 KB (WebP). 6 MB video loads only near the viewport. Image dimensions added. Verified in headless Chromium at 1280/390 px: only the logo loads before scroll, no JS errors. | #15 |
| Tracking / consent / disputed claims | **Flagged, not changed** (needs your approval) | — |

### Phase 2: research and content engine (#16)
`automation/engine` covers:
- page inventory and a budgeted Semrush client
- robots-respecting competitor snapshots
- signals with provenance on every number
- the opportunity engine: one of `new_page`, `improve_page`, `rewrite_title_meta`, `add_internal_links`, `consolidate_cannibalization`, `differentiate_pages`, `refresh_outdated` or `no_action`, with a 28-day cooling-off after changes
- briefs that include a facts registry blocking NinjaTrader and "ten rules"
- optional Claude drafting into the site template with sanitised HTML
- a quality gate checking originality, stuffing, filler, forbidden/disputed claims, and that third-party figures carry an inline source and a verified date
- PR proposals (allowlisted paths, ≤3 open, never merges)
- performance tracking (28 days before vs days 7–34 after)

**Real data used:** I pulled 92 rows from 5 Semrush reports via the connected Semrush MCP. ⚠️ **Semrush reported 5,470 API units for these calls**, more than planned because related and question reports cost ~90–110 units per row. I stopped there. The engine now reserves those observed costs, and all its Semrush calls are off with caps at 0 by default.

The first research report is `automation/engine/reports/2026-10-16-initial-research.md`. Highlights:
- "how to copy trade on tradovate" is 480/mo (KD 18), and three of our pages compete for it.
- `/prop-firm-copy-trading/` doesn't answer "how to copy trade on topstep" (140/mo).
- Generic "copy trading" (4,400, KD 71) is correctly excluded as off-target.
- Semrush has no organic data for usetradelink.com, and no GSC rows were available here.

**Content produced:** #17 (the first change from the engine's findings) gives the repeated callout a page-specific version on 8 pages and rewrites 11 "TradeLink advertises…" passages as first-party statements. It changes no facts.

### Phase 3 and 4: approvals and dashboard
- The executor now records `published_paths`, so every approved change enters tracking.
- A new end-to-end test covers the whole chain, with mocked GitHub and Slack and real Postgres:
  1. engine PR
  2. discovery
  3. Slack post with the exact SHA
  4. a signed Approve
  5. a merge of **that SHA only**
  6. a tracked change

  Reject, a disarmed service and a dev-branch deploy all publish nothing.
- The dashboard is a separate read-only service: Basic auth, 429 lockout, read-only transactions, strict CSP, no JS. It has 10 sections (opportunities, GSC performance, research metrics, competitors, pages to improve, drafts/PRs, pending Slack approvals, published changes and outcomes, API usage, health). It was run locally against the real engine output.

### Test evidence (local Postgres 16 + GitHub Actions)
| Suite | Tests | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Engine (#16), incl. 4 end-to-end and 21 DB tests | 65 | pass (CI green) |
| Approvals (#11/#16) | 51 | pass (CI green) |
| Collector (#12) | 25 | pass (CI green) |
| Site checks + build (#15) | 11 | pass (CI green) |

**Failed or not run:**
- No live tests of Railway, Slack, GSC or Cloudflare: the hosts are blocked from this sandbox.
- No live Semrush v4 test of the collector's endpoint.

### Requires your approval or action
1. Decide NinjaTrader, "ten protection rules", competitor claim re-verification, tracking/consent.
2. Cloudflare Pages build command `python3 scripts/build_site.py`, output `_site` (before merging any automation PR).
3. Import the `main` ruleset. Point Railway services at `main` with "Wait for CI".
4. Merge order: #12→#8, #11→#9, #16; site #13→#15→#17.
5. Budgets and credentials for optional engine features: `ENGINE_SEMRUSH_*`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ENGINE_GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Checkpoint, 2026-10-16 late evening: production-readiness pass
Nothing was merged, deployed, published, bought or re-budgeted. `PUBLISHING_ENABLED` is unchanged. **No Semrush requests were made in this pass.**

### Phase 1: existing code finalized
- The stacked PRs are consolidated into two releases:
  - [#18](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/18): site
  - [#19](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/19): automation
- Every original head is verified as an ancestor, so no fix is omitted or duplicated.
- **CI on #19 (head `271689c`):** all pass — site-checks, seo-content-integrity, python-tests, approval-gateway-tests, engine-tests, live-site-crawl.
- **CI on #18:** site-checks pass.
- Bugs found and fixed in this pass:
  - The engine's Semrush run rolled back its own transaction, which threw away paid-for metrics and usage rows.
  - Briefed opportunities never lapsed after the page was fixed.
  - The on-page overlap check counted an Apex-specific page as competing with the general Tradovate guide.
  - The quality gate missed "ten protection rules" in table cells.
  - `check_site` scanned `_site/` when run inside a git worktree.

### Phase 2: deployment preparation (ordered steps: `docs/ops/activation-checklist.md` in #19)
- **Real verification on GitHub runners against the actual Cloudflare previews:** `cloudflare-preview` fails, as designed, until Cloudflare builds `_site`.
  - #18: 24/41 checks pass. Pages, assets, GTM tracking, security headers and the 404 page are fine. **17 private files return HTTP 200.**
  - #19: 24/104 checks pass. **All of `automation/**`, `docs/**`, `.github/**` and `scripts/**` return HTTP 200 on its preview URL.**
  - No credentials are in the repo (only `.env.example` placeholders), but the code and the research data are public on preview URLs. Checklist step 1 (and optionally step 2) fixes this.
- GitHub:
  - Ruleset JSON with 5 required checks.
  - Import order: `site-checks` only first, then all 5 after #19, so nothing blocks itself.
  - The approval executor merges only the reviewed SHA (GitHub `sha` parameter, squash) and verifies protection at runtime.
- Railway:
  - `railway.json` for all four services.
  - Engine pre-deploy migrations, cron schedules, `/health`.
  - SQL for the read-only dashboard role.
  - The branch gate stops non-`main` deploys from ever arming.

### Phase 3: workflow verification. Real versus simulated, stated plainly
- **Real:**
  - GitHub Actions CI.
  - Cloudflare preview deployments checked over HTTP from GitHub runners.
  - The engine run on the real Semrush snapshot and real site files, which produced the opportunities below.
  - Quality gate, `content_guard` and `check_site` on every proposal.
- **Simulated (mocked GitHub/Slack, real Postgres):**
  - The end-to-end pipeline test: proposal → Slack message → Approve/Reject/Request changes → SHA-bound merge → change tracking.
- **Not verified (unreachable from the sandbox):** live Railway services, PB Assist in Slack, Search Console ingestion, the live Semrush v4 collector.

### Phase 4: Semrush spending lockdown
- **Every path is now fail-closed:**
  - Collector v4 and engine v3 caps default to 0.
  - The engine has a per-call cap.
  - `SEMRUSH_KILL_SWITCH`, plus a shared DB pause (`engine.run spend --pause/--resume`).
  - Auto-pause when real cost (from Semrush's free balance endpoint) exceeds the estimate.
  - One Semrush run at a time (advisory lock).
  - The month cap counts both services.
- Assistant sessions: `mcp__Semrush__execute_report` is denied in `.claude/settings.json`, and this took effect in this session.
- No background agents run.

### Phase 5: campaign 1 and three draft proposals (snapshot data only)
- Campaign document: `automation/engine/reports/2026-10-16-campaign-1.md`. It covers 6 prioritized items with intent, evidence, coverage, change, benefit and status, plus what was not pursued and why.
- [#20](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/20): one page answers "how to copy trade on Tradovate" (480/mo, KD 18). The second page gets its own intent, and the unconfirmed "ten rules" is removed.
- [#21](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/21): answers "how to copy trade on Topstep" (140/mo). It uses only facts already sourced from Topstep, and honestly says TradeLink doesn't list TopstepX.
- [#22](https://github.com/ThomasPeakBot/usetradelink/pull/22): sources and dates `/futures-trade-copier/` ("futures trade copier" 140/mo, KD 6). The quality gate went from fail to pass.
- All three pass `check_site`, the site tests, `content_guard` and the engine quality gate.
- Re-running the engine on #20 and #21 clears their opportunities.
- They are labelled-off on purpose, so nothing posts to Slack until you choose.

### Phase 6: activation status
See the issue body and `docs/ops/activation-checklist.md`: 19 ordered steps, each with status, settings page, change, risk, verification and rollback.

**Next action (owner):** checklist step 1 (Cloudflare build → `_site`). Then re-run `deploy-verify` on #18, and merge #18 when it is green.
